Legal

Licence terms

Last updated: 2026-10-22

What you buy

A purchase is a one-time payment for a personal, perpetual supporter licence for Wren. It is not a subscription: there is no renewal and no recurring charge.

The licence covers every version of Wren, the 1.0 and the updates after it included. The price may rise after 1.0; licences bought before keep covering the updates.

Wren's source code is public under the PolyForm Strict License 1.0.0: noncommercial use is free, redistribution, sale and changes are not allowed, and commercial use needs the author's agreement. During the beta the licence unlocks nothing: no feature, no version, no support level; it is a way to support the development. Once Wren is out of beta, the updates that follow need a licence.

Your key

The licence is a signed key, checked by Wren on your computer, offline. Keep it for yourself: it is personal, and it works on every computer you use.

If a purchase is refunded or reversed, the licence ends, as described in the refund policy.

Seller and payment

Wren is supplied by Froment Software. Payments are processed by Paddle, who act as Merchant of Record: they sell the licence on behalf of Froment Software and handle VAT, invoices and receipts.

See the privacy policy for what is stored when you buy, and the refund policy for refunds and withdrawal.

Warranty and liability

Wren is provided as is, without warranty of any kind, to the extent permitted by law. The licence is a contribution to the development of the software, not a promise of a particular result.

Nothing in these terms limits the rights that mandatory consumer law gives you, nor any liability that cannot be limited by law.

Questions

Write to contact@froment.software or open an issue on GitHub. The seller's details are on the imprint page.
